Statement on the Loss of Servicemembers | Press Releases | Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick Facebook Icon Google Plus Icon Instagram Icon LinkedIn Icon Twitter Icon YouTube Icon Vimeo Icon Clients Icon Email icon Map Icon Print Icon Quote Icon icon_share Carousel Arrow - Left Carousel Arrow - Right Press Releases Home Media Press Releases Print Statement on the Loss of Servicemembers July 19 , 2026 America’s servicemen and women are the guardians of liberty and the very best of our Nation—ordinary citizens who willingly accept extraordinary sacrifice. This weekend, we mourn the loss of true American heroes who answered their country’s call with courage and honor. We pray for the safe return of missing servicemembers, the full recovery of those wounded, and every military family whose sacrifice is so often borne in quiet. May we always prove worthy of the brave men and women who selflessly place themselves in harm’s way so that freedom may endure and peace may prevail. Res. 89 | Press Releases | Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick Facebook Icon Google Plus Icon Instagram Icon LinkedIn Icon Twitter Icon YouTube Icon Vimeo Icon Clients Icon Email icon Map Icon Print Icon Quote Icon icon_share Carousel Arrow - Left Carousel Arrow - Right Press Releases Home Media Press Releases Print Fitzpatrick Statement on H.R. 9770, H. Con. Res. 113, and H. Con. Res. 89 July 22 , 2026 End the war. Pay our troops. Fund our government. Oppose any and all pay raises for elected officials. This should be the unequivocal position of every elected official in America. I will continue to follow the law and will vote to enforce the War Powers Act of 1973, and I will support any clean resolutions following the statutory 60-day time period. I will vote to continue to pay our troops, provide them with protective and defensive equipment, and ensure that our national defense inventory remains at safe levels. I will continue to fund our government, oppose any and all government shutdowns, and ensure that all of our federal workers are always paid. And I will always oppose any and all pay raises for elected officials. No exceptions. Every single vote that I cast will reflect these basic, incontrovertible truths. And I call on all elected officials to do the same. Permalink: https://fitzpatrick.house.gov/2026/7/fitzpatrick-statement-on-h-r-9770-and-h-con-res-113 Issues
